def: An agent or process that rewrites another agent, tests the rewrite and keeps it only if it scores better.
Swapping the agent a loop discovered into the outer loop's seat and checking whether it is a better improver than the original.
The capstone artifact: a small-scale replication of Weco's AIDE² outer loop, judged by the four Level-1 conditions.
The fixed two-to-six-page shape every artifact ships in: claim, replication, extension, negative results, hacking rate and costs, and a one-command reproduction.
